records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales increased $35.5 million, or 14.0%, to $288.8 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025 as compared to $253.4 million in the same period in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The net sales increase was primarily driven by volume gains of 12.9% and favorable price/mix of 1.1%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase was partially offset by a decrease of $4.1 million in accounts receivable, a decrease of $10.9 million in inventories, net, a decrease of $6.7 million in prepaid expenses, and an increase of $1.0 million in lease liabilities.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Selling, general and administrative expenses ("SG&A") were $89.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025, compared to $90.3 million in the prior year period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As a result of the factors discussed above, income from operations increased by $13.0 million to income from operations of $24.9 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025 as compared to income from operations of $11.9 million in the prior year period.
